questions.question: Which of these are **prime numbers**?
questions.explanation: 9 = 3 × 3 and 21 = 3 × 7; 2, 13 and 29 have no other divisor than 1 and themselves.

questions.question: Complete the flowchart: it says whether **n** is even or odd.
questions.explanation: n mod 2 is the remainder of n divided by 2: 0 for an even number.

questions.question: Put the planets in order, from the **closest to the Sun** to the farthest.
questions.explanation: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, then the gas giant Jupiter, past the asteroid belt.

questions.question: Draw the curve of **y = x²**.
questions.explanation: A parabola: 0 at x = 0, 1 at ±1, 4 at ±2, 9 at ±3, symmetric about the y axis.
